results.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
results.snippet: BOLA (also called IDOR) is a class of API authorization flaw where a server fails to verify that the caller may access a specific object.

results.title: Broken Function Level Authorization
results.snippet: BFLA occurs when a server exposes function-level capabilities to callers that should not be authorized.

safety_boundary: Local knowledge only. The system does not scan external systems.
